## 2. RTL/LTR FINAL HARDENING REPORT

### Critical RTL Fix: Graph Info Panel
- **Issue:** `.graph-info-panel` used `right: 16px` — panel appeared in wrong corner in Arabic RTL mode
- **Fix:** Changed to `inset-inline-end: 16px` (CSS logical property — automatically resolves to `right` in LTR and `left` in RTL)
- **File:** `graph.component.scss`
- **Impact:** Info panel now correctly positions top-right in LTR and top-left in RTL

### New RTL Rules Added to `styles.scss`
The following RTL overrides were added to the `[dir="rtl"], body.rtl` block:

**Graph RTL:**
```scss
.graph-header { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.graph-stats-bar { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.graph-controls { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.graph-controls__section { align-items: flex-end; }
.graph-legend { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.graph-info-panel__header { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.graph-info-panel__body { text-align: right; }
.graph-info-row { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.strength-bar { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
```

**Chat RTL:**
```scss
.chat-sidebar { direction: rtl; }
.chat-sidebar__header { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.chat-sidebar__search { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.chat-session-item { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.chat-navbar { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.chat-navbar__identity { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.chat-message--user { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.chat-input-box { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.chat-attachments-bar { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.chat-message__bubble { text-align: right; }
.chat-message--user .chat-message__bubble { text-align: left; }
```

### Pre-existing RTL Coverage (verified intact)

### Verification: Auth Validators
- `getEmailErrorHintKey()` — returns LanguageService translation keys ✅

### Language Switching Behavior
- Validation messages update immediately on language switch because all error message rendering reads `lang.t()` on every change detection cycle

## 5. SEO LOCALIZATION REVIEW

### `index.html` Analysis
- `<html lang="en">` — Static default. **Acceptable**: `LanguageService.applyLanguage()` calls `html.setAttribute('lang', lang)` in its constructor before first render. The attribute is always set correctly at runtime.
- `<meta name="description">` — English only. SEO meta description is not dynamically switched (this is a known limitation — server-side rendering would be needed for true SEO localization)
- `<title>AegisLex — AI Legal Intelligence Platform</title>` — English only (same limitation)

### SEO Findings
| Item | Status | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| `<html lang>` attribute | ✅ Correct at runtime | Set dynamically by LanguageService |
| `<meta description>` | ⚠️ English only | Risk-free to leave — SSR not in scope |
| `<title>` | ⚠️ English only | Risk-free to leave — SSR not in scope |
| Angular route titles | Not set | No `Route.title` configured — lower priority |

**Recommendation:** Implement Angular `Router` `title` strategy + `Meta` service updates on language switch in a future phase. No risky changes applied now.

## 9. ROOT CAUSES FOUND

1. **Graph component never had LanguageService injected** — all labels were hardcoded English static strings in HTML and TS
2. **Graph info panel positioned with `right: 16px`** — non-logical CSS property breaks RTL layout
3. **Report viewer footer** — three hardcoded English strings (disclaimer text, "Confidential", "AI-Generated Report")
4. **Missing graph + chat RTL rules** in global `styles.scss` RTL block

## 11. RISK ASSESSMENT

| Change | Risk Level | Justification |
|--------|-----------|---------------|
| New translation keys in language service | 🟢 Zero | Additive only; existing keys untouched |
| Graph HTML localization | 🟢 Zero | `lang.t()` returns EN string as default; graph rendering untouched |
| Graph TS: `inject(LanguageService)` | 🟢 Zero | Standard Angular DI; no lifecycle changes |
| Graph TS: layouts as key strings | 🟢 Zero | Template does `lang.t(l.label)` — identical rendering |
| Graph TS: `getNodeTypeLabel()` localized | 🟢 Zero | Returns same English text in EN mode; Arabic in AR mode |
| Graph SCSS: `inset-inline-end` | 🟢 Zero | CSS3 logical properties supported by all modern browsers; LTR behavior identical |
| RTL rules in styles.scss | 🟢 Zero | Only apply when `[dir="rtl"]` or `body.rtl` — no LTR impact |
| Report viewer footer localization | 🟢 Zero | `langService` already injected; `lang.t()` used elsewhere in file |
